nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, this is the set of complex-valued Schwartz functions $f$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$ that are radial: $f(x) = f(y)$ whenever $|x| = |y|$.
nodes.title: Radial Schwartz functions

nodes.summary: A function is radial if it takes the same value at points with the same norm.
nodes.title: Radial function

nodes.summary: For a natural number $k_0$, this is the set of families $(a_{k,j})$ of complex numbers indexed by the integers $k \ge k_0$ and $j \in \{0, 1, 2, 3\}$ whose four sequences $(a_{k,j})_{k \ge k_0}$ are all rapidly decreasing: $k^m |a_{k,j}| \to 0$ as $k \to \infty$ for every $j$ and every natural number $m$.
nodes.title: Rapidly decreasing sample data

nodes.summary: For a natural number $k_0$, a family $(a_{k,j})$ of complex numbers indexed by the integers $k \ge k_0$ and $j \in \{0, 1, 2, 3\}$ is a rapidly decreasing quadruple if each of its four sequences $(a_{k,j})_{k \ge k_0}$ is rapidly decreasing, that is, $k^m |a_{k,j}| \to 0$ as $k \to \infty$ for every $j$ and every natural number $m$.
nodes.title: Rapidly decreasing sample quadruples

nodes.summary: For a natural number $k_0$, a complex sequence $(a_k)_{k \ge k_0}$ indexed by the integers $k \ge k_0$ is rapidly decreasing if $k^m |a_k| \to 0$ as $k \to \infty$ for every natural number $m$.
nodes.title: Rapidly decreasing sequences

nodes.summary: For a positive integer $n$, this is the map $\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}^n$ sending $r$ to $(r, 0, \dots, 0)$, whose image is the first coordinate axis.
nodes.title: Embedding of the first coordinate axis

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
